ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Response to the Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's response to the shooting of Alex Pretti and explore the implications of their actions.
questions: What was the Trump administration's response to the shooting?
What are the implications of their actions?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant information about the Trump administration's priorities and values. By following the money and investigating the administration's response, we may uncover a larger pattern of misconduct.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Federal Freeze on the Hudson River Tunnel Project
ideas.description: This story would explore the impact of the federal freeze on the Hudson River Tunnel project and the region's infrastructure and economy.
questions: What is the impact of the federal freeze on the project?
How will this affect the region's infrastructure and economy?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant information about the impact of the federal freeze on critical infrastructure projects. By analyzing data and public records, we may uncover a larger pattern of federal funding being withheld from important projects.
